notes: Posted 18 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III.

Starting cards as posted (marked '(Starting)'): No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Fear Is My Ally, Prepared Defenses, You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points and Imperial Arrest Order & Secret Plans. All count toward the 60.
The list totals 59 as published: the Characters header says 29 but lists 28; kept as posted. The ten Defensive Shields are posted outside the 60.
The draft read the 'Defensive Shields (10)' header as 10 Defensive Fire; that row is removed.

Posted shields 'Oppresive Enforcement', 'There Is No Try', 'Resistence', 'Leave Them To Me', 'Wipe Them Out, All Of Them', 'You Cannot Hide Forever' and 'Do They Have A Code Clearance?' dested the Reflections III Defensive Shield pages (the '(Dark)' titles), not the older Effects of the same names.

Posted 'Tatooine Watto's Junkyard' and 'Tatooine Mos Espa' dested the Dark printed sites Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard (Dark) and Tatooine: Mos Espa (Dark) (the draft had picked later Virtual versions); 'Tatooine Docking Bay 94' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94 (Dark); 'Prepared Defenses' the printed Death Star II card, not Prepared Defenses (V).
Posted 'Tatooine' dested the Dark Premiere system Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere); the post does not say which printing (Premiere or Coruscant).

Posted 'Jabba' dested the Special Edition character Jabba (the strategy says 'Why the Special Edition Jabba'); 'Vibro-Ax' the Dark Jabba's Palace weapon Vibro-Ax (Dark); 'Vader with Lightsaber' Darth Vader With Lightsaber; 'Commader Merrejk' Commander Merrejk; 'Executor' the Dagobah starship Executor.
